rationale: German month pages for the seven cities whose climate data already passed the plausibility gates. Demand measured in the German database on 2026-09-22 with the phrase 'wetter {Stadt} {Monat}' (85 rows, 1,023 units, plus 88 units for the phrasing test that chose it over 'rom wetter mai' and 'wetter rom im mai'). Months below 100 searches a month are held back by the funnel, not by hand.
